page_shape.entry: comeet.com posting: button#showApplyForm 'Apply for this job' reveals iframe#iFrameResizer0 name comeet-applyform-* src www.comeet.co/jobs/<cuid>/<puid>/apply?token=…&embedded=true. Also a 'social' iframe (apply with LinkedIn etc.).
page_shape.form: form#applyForm (Angular, method attr get, action empty; submission is JS/XHR). Header text 'Fields marked with * are mandatory.' Standard block, then employer question fieldsets, then 'Please review our privacy practices: Privacy policy: <Company>' link, then 'SUBMIT APPLICATION'.
page_shape.captcha: Google reCAPTCHA v2 anchor iframe (www.google.com/recaptcha/api2/anchor, site key 6Ld2jG4s…) present on every sample — invisible/badge style; expect token check at submit.

control_families.text: input#inputFirstName[name=firstName], #inputLastName[name=lastName], #inputEmail[type=email], #inputTel[type=tel] (phone with country selector enabled via ?field-phone-country-selector=true), #inputLink[type=url][name=websiteUrl]; <label> text ends with ' *' when required; aria-label without star.
control_families.file: input[type=file]#cv[name=cv] REQUIRED accept .pdf,.doc,.docx,.rtf (+MIME); #coverLetter and #portfolio optional (no accept attr); each has a visible 'Attach …' label button.
control_families.question_text: fieldset > .question-header (title, trailing ' *' if required) + input[type=text].form-control whose name AND id equal the full question text.
control_families.question_dropdown: fieldset with div.dropdown: a.dropdown-toggle 'Choose' + ul.dropdown-menu li > a.notBranded > div.option-title; options are in the DOM without opening.
control_families.question_radio: fieldset with ul.options li input[type=radio].checkbox (visually hidden, styled with fa-stack) + label.checkboxLabel; name = question text.
control_families.info_block: a fieldset whose header is an instruction paragraph and whose input is an (optional) text field — employer used a 'text question' as a notice (cm-01).

runtime_observations: Question field names/ids are the literal question text (may include newlines) — match by .question-header text, not by id.
Dropdown options exist in DOM (ul.dropdown-menu) before opening; selecting requires clicking li>a, not a native select.
Radio inputs are hidden; click the label.checkboxLabel.
Cover letter is a FILE upload, not a textarea; Personal note textarea is the only free-text narrative field on the standard block.

inferred.confidence: high for standard block (identical on 4/4); custom questions vary

provider_hint.for_jev: Comeet: single iframe form — first/last name, email, phone (required), Resume file REQUIRED (pdf/doc/docx/rtf), optional website URL, optional Cover Letter FILE, optional Portfolio FILE, optional 'Personal note' textarea, then employer screening questions (dropdown/radio Yes-No, short text such as state of residence or total compensation figure, radio salary-range confirmation, time zone). reCAPTCHA v2 at submit. 'SUBMIT APPLICATION' is the stop boundary.
